title: What If You Fell Through a Tunnel Across the Entire Earth?
start_frame_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 cinematic science documentary view looking down into a perfectly engineered circular tunnel opening in barren rock, safety rail removed for visualization, tunnel descends impossibly deep, a small instrumented test capsule at the rim for scale, natural daylight, realistic rock microtexture, premium large-format cinema camera, no text, no diagram, no fantasy glow.
negative_prompt: cartoon, infographic, flat earth cross section, labels, text, molten tunnel walls, person burning, gore, fantasy portal, neon, cheap CGI, game render, malformed geometry, black bars, seams
narration: Imagine a vacuum tunnel straight through Earth, with heat and pressure somehow engineered away. Drop into it and gravity accelerates you toward the center. But as you descend, less of Earth's mass lies beneath you, so the inward pull changes. At the exact center, gravitational pulls balance — yet your speed is greatest, so you shoot straight through. Then gravity slows you on the far side. With no air resistance or friction, you would oscillate back and forth instead of stopping at the center. Real Earth, of course, makes such a tunnel impossible.
captions: IMAGINE A VACUUM TUNNEL THROUGH EARTH.
GRAVITY PULLS YOU TOWARD THE CENTER.
AT THE CENTER: ZERO NET GRAVITY, MAX SPEED.
NO FRICTION? YOU OSCILLATE BACK AND FORTH.

scenes.prompt: Continue from the exact tunnel opening. The instrumented test capsule drops vertically into the shaft in the first second and the camera dives after it, maintaining believable scale and rapid parallax along engineered tunnel lining embedded in natural crustal rock. Daylight falls away into realistic darkness with capsule lights revealing texture. This is a hypothetical engineered vacuum tunnel; do not show a human body or injury. No cut, no infographic, no labels.

Continue the same capsule accelerating deeper in the identical shaft. Use an impossible cinematic camera that briefly moves outside the tunnel wall into a photoreal volumetric cutaway of Earth's deep layers while preserving the capsule's exact path and orientation, then returns beside it. Show pressure/heat only as surrounding material conditions, never entering the engineered tunnel. Convey changing gravity through increasing capsule speed, not arrows or text. Premium geological realism.

Maintain continuity as the capsule reaches Earth's exact center. Camera locks beside it for a dramatic near-weightless instant while surrounding planetary material is symmetrically distributed in a scientifically inspired deep-Earth visualization. The capsule is moving fastest and crosses the center without stopping. No glowing core fantasy, no hovering pause, no force arrows, no diagram. Preserve shaft geometry and motion direction with strong cinematic depth.

Continue immediately beyond the center with the same capsule moving toward the opposite surface. Camera races ahead and looks back as the capsule gradually decelerates while climbing through the same continuous shaft. Deep-Earth surroundings transition coherently toward mantle and crust. No reversal yet, no hard cut, no labels. Photoreal rock, physically consistent motion, premium science documentary visualization.

The capsule approaches the opposite tunnel mouth with speed falling toward zero, nearly reaches the surface, then begins falling back into the same shaft, demonstrating oscillation in the frictionless hypothetical. Camera rises into daylight just enough to reveal the opposite landscape and then tilts down as the capsule reverses. End on the repeating descent. No crash, no ejection, no fantasy, no generated text, no black bars or seams.

production_notes.director_intent: One continuous fall through a physically coherent Earth tunnel; spectacle comes from scale and impossible camera, not a flat cross-section.
production_notes.science_guard: State explicit idealizations: vacuum, engineered heat/pressure solution, no friction. Do not imply a real tunnel is feasible. At center net gravity is zero but velocity is maximum.
production_notes.sound_design: Deep aerodynamic-like cinematic movement is restrained because tunnel is vacuum; use capsule structural resonance and score texture, not wind as literal in-world sound.
